theorems.name: Submission.rsod_tv_support_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ) (W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' U)), W.weight = V.weight.map (fun y => y - x₀) → W.support = (fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' V.support
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
